test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.

You must meet / Suyash sometime. / I think you like him.
solution:
The correct answer is:** 'I think you like him'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in **'I think you like him'.**
 
• The sentence has an error of **'Sequence of Tense'.**
 
• In this sentence, the speaker gives a proposal to the another person. So, the other part of the sentence should be in **'Future Tense'.**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **'Option 2'.**

**Correct sentence:__ ***You must meet Suyash sometime. I think you **will** like him.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **'Suyash sometime'** is the correct part of the sentence.
 
• **'You must meet'** is the correct part of the sentence.
